title: Vihisishi (Theme 3: Mavazi)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 4 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the feeling first and then chooses the exclamation and the alama ya hisi that show it.
representations: a chart of exclamations by feeling

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Pole!" and one more exclamation for a happy event.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mwenzako ameanguka na kuumia. Utasema ___!" Kwa nini "Hongera" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kihisishi huonyesha hisia: "Pole!" kwa huzuni, "Hongera!" kwa mafanikio, "Samahani!" ukikosea, "Karibu!" kwa mgeni.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Hongera! Juma ameshinda mbio za shule. Ni kihisishi kipi?" Kwa nini "Juma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kihisishi kinaonyesha hisia na huandikwa pamoja na alama ya hisi (!). "Juma" ni nomino.

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili linaonyesha hisia? Linafuatwa na alama gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kihisishi hufuatwa na alama ya hisi: Lo!

misconceptions.ask: Neno hili ni la lugha gani?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa Kiswahili tunasema Lo! au Ala! kwa mshangao.
